An '''ion mini-torpedo''' was a type of [[Mini-Torpedo|mini-torpedo]] that functioned as an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weapon]]. Like other mini-torpedoes, it only functioned [[Water/Legends|underwater]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
